description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source files within a specific directory (`src/plugins`) to detect import boundary violations related to plugin extensions. It performs inventory collection, comparison with expected results, and reports on disallowed imports and registry smells.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for inventory entries used for sorting and diffing.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for a resolved extension path, used in reporting violations.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an inventory entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a TypeScript source file for import boundary violations related to plugins.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects specific registry smell patterns in the web search providers file.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped during inventory collection.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory of import boundary violations across plugin source files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the expected inventory JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Diffs the expected and actual inventory collections.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the baseline inventory check with configured functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, executes the import boundary check script.
